name: Negeb
line: The Negev is the dry southern region of Canaan, where Abram traveled, Isaac lived, and the spies passed through, and where Caleb's daughter Acsah received land.

moments.title: Abram travels toward the Negev
moments.text: Abram journeyed on toward the Negev, but a severe famine sent him down to Egypt. Later he came back up into the Negev with his wife, Lot, and all his possessions.

moments.title: Isaac lives in the Negev
moments.text: Isaac was living in the Negev after returning from Beer-lahai-roi. One evening he saw Rebekah coming, and he took her as his wife and was comforted.

moments.title: The spies go through the Negev
moments.text: Moses sent men to spy out Canaan and told them to go up through the Negev. They came to Hebron and cut a huge cluster of grapes in the Valley of Eshcol.

moments.title: Acsah receives land in the Negev
moments.text: Caleb gave his daughter Acsah land in the Negev. She asked him for springs of water as well, and he gave her the upper and lower springs.
